Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill
Results.ReviewText: I really like the flip grate option.  I have used them both thin grates up, thick grates up, and even 1 each side by side.  Fun to experiment and all we've grilled thus far has come out perfectly. I did experience as another reviewer did the bullet holes in the pan liner.  At first I thought the 10 pack I bought was defective and inspected them all and was puzzled by the sudden appearance of holes and grease drip swimming in the tray.  The other review suspected too long in the tray.  I put parchment paper between the tray and the pan liner cut to size and have not had any more holes.  Other than that the grill is outstanding.  The igniter is high quality.  The hang for the propane tank is a snap and the level of gas reading is spot on.  As others have said, it burns with incredible efficiency.  We grill tons.  Everything we've made is noticably better than our previous grill.  It is easy to clean and the construction is solid. No cheesy wheels either! This may sound silly but I love raising and lowering the lid.  It is like a door on a high end vehicle.  The thermometer is a big plus too as we have never had one built on the grill.  It's our 1st season with this grill and I can tell there will be many many more.
Results.Title: Cooks -everything- beautifully.

Results.ReviewText: Bought the Spirit for its simple yet durable construction!!  The two piece cast shell is nearly indestructible!  Everything else will be easily replaced when needed!  Hence 10yr warranty!  The equal temps inside make grilling a breeze!!  No frills ,just right!!
Results.Title: Simple yet durable!!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
Needed a second grill for a small condo we own, and had a positive experience with a Genesis grill I've owned for many years.When I checked out reviews for cheaper brands, it was clear that they just don't last. Better to spend a few more dollars up front and get a grill that will provide good results for many years. This Spirit II E-210 filled the bill perfectly.

Had one initial problem--igniter didn't work. Filed warranty claim online and the issue was handled promptly. Replacement parts were sent and the grill works perfectly now. Good indicator of Weber's commitment to customer service.
Results.Title: Fine smaller size gas grill

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Through my first grilling season. Grill is awesome. Perfect every time....
Results.Title: Excellent!!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: 1st Weber and I will never buy anything else.  Easy to put together and everything works perfect.  Cooks Wonderful
Results.Title: Great Grill In All Aspects

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Love this grill.  Heats fast, even temperature, great taste, nice char.  And easy clean-up.
Results.Title: Awesome grill!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I have had this for 4 years. It has always been a problem... at first it was great then it would only get warm and not hot.... I got this fixed but now it won't get hot again, and only one burner works. Pretty disappointed overall with this. It's not like we use it the whole time either.
Results.Title: Never really worked well

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I bought this grill after replacing another manufacturers grill.  We shopped around and kept comparing this to others and found the materials to be superior and the 10 year warranty and reputation of Weber outstanding.  We love the way it grills, the only drawback is the shelf used to move the grill is also the shelf to help move it and it becomes unhinged sometimes while wheeling the grill.  Otherwise fantastic!
Results.Title: Perfect for our house

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Now that I no longer have all my children and grandkids living with me I needed a smaller grill. I am so happy with the Weber grill. It is compact in size but still quite powerful. Weber certainly is an excellent choice.
Results.Title: Happy I purchased my Weber grill

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I've traditionally had the large BBQ's (5 burners plus side burner) and have found that the first 2 to 3 burners got all the use with the side burner getting very little or no use.  The Spirit II was a good choice for me, being a smaller BBQ.  I've found that it heats up extremely fast, wasting less propane.  It has lots of room to BBQ food for four people.
Results.Title: Small but Mighty

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
